principles.label: Context before compute
principles.signal: Use more reasoning and targeted reads before running heavy commands.
principles.guardrail: Avoid broad scans of generated caches, dependency folders, and build output.

principles.label: Static-first validation
principles.signal: Prefer syntax checks, JSON contract checks, and targeted foundation gates.
principles.guardrail: Run production builds only when release packaging or deployment readiness requires them.

principles.label: Cinematic with fallbacks
principles.signal: Increase atmosphere through CSS, canvas, and content rhythm before adding GPU-heavy layers.
principles.guardrail: Every immersive effect needs reduced-motion and mobile-safe behavior.

principles.label: Small reversible diffs
principles.signal: Ship one coherent surface at a time so rollback stays simple.
principles.guardrail: Keep unrelated repo noise out of the current development slice.

nextSteps: Keep enriching the public lab surface with JSON-backed modules.
Add heavier 3D only after a dependency and performance budget note.
Preserve static release readiness until the server target is confirmed.
